children: Our Bureau New Delhi: RPS Ventures, a fund set up by former SoftBank Vision Fund managing partner Kabir Misra, on Wednesday sold 38.6 million shares in Meesho for 899.7 crore through multiple block deals, as per BSE data. Norges Bank, Fidelity, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and Citigroup were among the buyers of the shares, which represent a 0.9% stake in Meesho. Shares changed hands at 233 apiece.

Meesho's stock ended 1.6% lower at 236.35 on the BSE. As of June 30, RPS Ventures held a 1.2% stake in Meesho. The fund, which has also backed companies such as Delhivery and Acko, first invested in Meesho in 2018 as part of a $50-million funding round that valued the company at $200-250 million.

title: RPS Sells 0.9% Stake in Meesho for Rs 900cr
